headline: Add free-agent QB Cooper Rush for Malik Willis now, then set Rush as Joe Burrow's AutoSub before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and Thursday's lineup calls (Jones over Judkins, Shakir and Jones in the flex spots) still hold today, nothing changed. The live issue is Burrow's back, limited in practice again Thursday with no official game-status tag yet, and a week 6 QB bye collision that a zero-cost free-agent QB fixes right now.

adds.why: fixes the week 6 double bye: Burrow and Willis both sit week 6, Rush's bye is 11
adds.evidence: Rush makes his 2nd straight start for Atlanta Sunday with Michael Penix (ACL, close to returning) and Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) both inactive, per Fri Sep 18 reports; Willis remains Miami's starter (room shows him QB1, no competition) but shares Burrow's week 6 bye so he gives Danny no cover that week

subs.why: Burrow was a limited practice participant Wed and Thu with back soreness and still has no official game-status designation as of Fri Sep 18; add Rush first (above), then set the pair before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff (both games kick off then)
